name: autocodeflow-monorepo
description: AutoCodeFlow monorepo root — unified command entry (per-app installs remain independent; no workspace hoisting by design, see ARCH-20)

scripts.test:registry-npm: echo 'registry-npm is verdaccio config only — see apps/registry-npm/README.md'
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:node && npm run test:python && npm run test:web && npm run test:cli && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:pypi && npm run test:sdk-py
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:cli && npm run typecheck:mcp && cd apps/admin-web && npm run typecheck
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web && cd apps/executor-node && npx eslint src
